issue.body:
One of the features I really like over in Falcon is "sinks" (note: framework isn't strictly equivalent, as it's WSGI): https://falcon.readthedocs.io/en/stable/api/api.html#falcon.API.add_sink

The idea is that you have a URL prefix that is explicitly passed off to a callable so that you can forward requests through to other systems alongside your primary application.

My particular use case for this would be to forward v1 API requests through to a legacy Django app, while building out the replacement ASGI server in Starlette over time.

Is this something that would make sense in the core library? I assume I could probably override Router or similar and roll my own solution, but it would be pretty neat if there were a first party router class that was built to pass requests through.
issue.title: [Feature request] Route "sinks"
